newsitem.title: ITALY: SAI chairman and man director step down.
newsitem.headline: SAI chairman and man director step down.

text.p: Italy's leading motor insurance company Societa' Assicuratrice Industriale (SAI) said its chairman Salvatore Ligresti and managing director Fausto Rapisarda are resigning from the group.

The two leading figures at the group announced their resignation by letter to the company's board, according to a spokesman at Premafin, the holding group of Ligresti, which together with French group GAN control SAI.

The company spokesman added that the SAI board should accept the resignation of the two and will decide on who should take their place at a board meeting, but the timing of such a meeting was not yet known.

The stepping down was demanded by Italian insurance watchdog Isvap after Ligresti and Rapisardo were found guilty of corruption charges relating to bribes paid by SAI to win an insurance contract from the state energy group ENI.

Stock market talk has continued to put SAI in the spotlight as a takeover candidate due the uncertainty regarding the group and by 1230 GMT, SAI shares were up 1.33 percent at 13,900 lire in a largely steady Milan stock market.
